📖 How to use

  1. Enter your TV's screen diagonal (inches or cm).

  3. Read the THX ideal distance plus the closest and farthest cinematic seating positions.

❓ Frequently asked questions

What do the THX 36° and SMPTE 30° angles mean?

THX recommends a minimum 36° horizontal viewing angle for a cinematic feel; SMPTE recommends at least 30°. This tool converts your screen width into seating distance with d = (width/2) / tan(angle/2).

Why is there a minimum and maximum distance?

The angles describe your field of view. Sitting closer than the 40° distance means you may see pixels and strain your eyes; sitting farther than the 30° distance means you lose the immersive feel.

Does 4K change the recommended distance?

1080p screens look best near the THX distance. 4K screens show full detail up to about 1.5× the diagonal — closer is fine for 4K, which is why the tool notes a 4K close-range too.
